comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Cable networks and streaming content; no live events, venues or ticketing, so a different business.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Baseball franchise earning from games, media rights and real estate; not a concert promoter or ticketing platform.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: B2B trade show organizer selling exhibit space; different customers and events from consumer concerts and ticketing.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Operates live music and entertainment venues, with ticketed events, sponsorship and concessions. This closely overlaps Live Nation's venue and concert business.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Gambling and iGaming operator; different product, customers and regulation despite some sports and entertainment overlap.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Theme park operator selling admission to visitors; not concert promotion or ticketing, though both are leisure attractions.
